schema.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `participations` group: the DID's ACTIVE `Participant` entries (non-ACTIVE entries never reach the search surface, per [TG-ACT-1]; the full lifecycle view is traversal query A7). `entries` MAY be truncated to an implementation-defined maximum; `total`, `ecosystemCount`, and `byRole` always reflect the untruncated population.

total.description: Count of the DID's ACTIVE Participant entries.

ecosystemCount.description: Count of distinct `Participant.ecosystemId` values among them.

byRole.description: Map role → count over the same entries; `{}` when `total = 0`.

propertyNames.description: Participant role per the `Participant` entity table.
propertyNames.title: search_response_ParticipantRole

byRole.title: search_response_RoleCountMap

entries.description: One entry per ACTIVE Participant; `[]` when `total = 0`.

id.description: Stable VPR `Participant.id` — the G1 traversal anchor.

role.description: Participant role per the `Participant` entity table.
role.title: search_response_ParticipantRole

schemaTitle.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

schema.title: search_response_DidSnippetParticipations
